title: Authorize system parameters with live menu authority and operational value guards
description: Stage 3 operational-configuration closure for the global parameters that feed operational document defaults. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/ParameterController.cs:13-16 declares [ApiController]/[Route("api/sys/parameters")]/[Authorize] with no identity or menu resolution; GetAll at 26-40, GetById at 43-49, GetByKey at 52-58, Create at 61-71 and Update at 74-85 read and rewrite SysParameters (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/SysSystem.cs:10-30) for any authenticated account. The DefaultCurrency and ExchangeRate parameters are consumed as authoritative fallbacks by src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BillProcController.cs:268-289 (LoadCurrencyDefaultsAsync) and 304-313 (ApplyCurrencyDefaultsAsync) when a bill omits currency or exchange rate, so an unguarded write can silently change the currency and rate defaults of newly saved operational documents. Reuse the existing sys-parameter functional menu (SeedData.Menus.cs:18) on every route and add bounded server-side validation for the persisted parameter columns plus explicit operational guards (supported currency codes, positive exchange rate), keeping BillProcController's existing parameter-driven default behaviour unchanged. Add no grants, no anonymous/admin fallback, no schema change. Genuine isolated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL only; safe Release build plus full ERP.UnitTests.
acceptance_criteria: For every route on /api/sys/parameters (list, by-id, by-key, create and update) require the current enabled nondeleted identity and the existing sys-parameter functional menu before any read or write, rejecting missing, disabled, deleted and revoked-menu identities with the existing controlled non-disclosing errors and adding no new grants or anonymous/admin fallback.

Validate on create and update that ParamKey and ParamName are non-empty within their persisted length bounds and that ParamKey stays unique among non-deleted parameters, that ParamValue and Description stay within their persisted bounds, and that the operational keys DefaultCurrency and ExchangeRate accept only a supported currency code and a positive parseable decimal respectively, so rejected writes persist no SysParameters row and leave the stored values, BillProcController's currency/exchange-rate fallback and existing system parameters unchanged.

Genuine isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover the permitted privileged and menu-granted flows, missing sys-parameter menu, disabled, deleted and revoked identities, duplicate or over-long keys and invalid DefaultCurrency and ExchangeRate values, and assert that denied create and update calls read or mutate no SysParameters row while the existing ParameterControllerTests contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, use only genuine isolated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST databases with Integrated Security, and add no schema, entity, menu, permission or production/secret change; build completion is not stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/ParameterController.cs:13-16 declares only [Authorize] with no identity/menu resolution; GetAll at 26-40, GetById at 43-49, GetByKey at 52-58, Create at 61-71 and Update at 74-85 read and write SysParameters with only a duplicate-key check at 64-65 and no caller, menu or value guard. SysParameter (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/SysSystem.cs:10-30) persists ParamKey/ParamValue/ParamName/Description with no server-side bound or domain rule. The consumed operational fallback is src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BillProcController.cs:268-289 (LoadCurrencyDefaultsAsync reads DefaultCurrency and ExchangeRate from SysParameters) and 304-313 (ApplyCurrencyDefaultsAsync applies them to saved bills), so unguarded writes change operational document currency/rate defaults. The existing sys-parameter menu is seeded at src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:18. An exact search of .ai/tasks returned no task listing ParameterController or SysParameter for live authorization.
